research_object.title: REMoDNaV: Robust Eye Movement Detection for Natural Viewing
research_object.scope: Numerical results, figures and manuscript, including explicitly linked computational components. Published input datasets are consumed in their supplied versioned states; reconstructing their original acquisition and unrelated fMRI/stimulus processing is outside this scope.

assessments.comment: Independent inspection-only assessment of frozen cohort remodnav-e3c6253bced7, manifest SHA256 e3c6253bced7d959cd59873c3d49d166bf5793906bcdf65e49e265076d215499. Actual source files, histories, registered image metadata, supplied annex availability metadata and explicitly linked adapter source were inspected. No network calls, scientific computation, payload retrieval, builds or independent reproduction were performed. Historical exit-zero records and README verification claims are attributed source evidence, not current observations of success. Required payloads are intentionally missing; no retrieval failures were observed. Two criteria remain unanswered because intended-version retrieval and uniform access conditions cannot be established responsibly. Scores describe this rubric perspective, not scientific validity or a certification.
